description: Reply as the recipient; the reply arrives as inbound email.

body.description:
The reply text, above the quoted original; empty or left out sends no text of
its own.

from.description: Who replies; defaults to the original recipient.

include_original.description: Quotes the original below an "On ... wrote:" line (default true).

reply_all.description: Also sends to the other original recipients, in Cc.

user_variables.description:
User variables for this action's webhooks, such as your app's order id, merged over the
email's own (Mailgun's `user-variables`, `data.user_variables` in templates), before
each payload is signed.

webhook_endpoint_ids.description:
Send this action's webhooks to exactly these endpoints (IDs from
`GET /api/v1/webhooks/endpoints`) instead of the ones the rules pick; an empty list
sends none. Leave it out to let the rules decide.

webhook_requests.description:
Payloads edited for this action, by endpoint: each body is sent as written instead of
the rendered one. Leave it out to send the rendered payloads.

name: sendmock_email_reply
